projects.name: / Engagement Lead / Transition Manager • Bangalore, India • Virginia, USA
details: Clients: Capital One, Lloyds Banking Group, Nortel
• Delivered Europe's largest data warehouse migration for Lloyds Banking Group — migrating 35 million
Halifax bank accounts onto the Lloyds platform using DataStage — leading a 17-person offshore team and
coordinating with client SMEs to deliver on schedule.
• Managed banking transformation, application support, migration, and transition programs across Capital
One, Lloyds Banking Group, and Nortel — spanning development, L3 incident management, and knowledge
transition across offshore and onshore teams in India, the UK, and the USA.

• Led offshore–onshore coordination and SLA delivery for Capital One's DDE data distribution platform — managing a team of 30, presenting daily/weekly/monthly status reports to the client, and ensuring L3
incident resolution and release governance targets were consistently met.
